name: Busa Lead Funnel
description: Deal sourcing pipeline for a BD/sourcing team triaging merchant and business financing leads: a kanban board across new/data-verified/scored/term-sheet-ready/rejected stages with deterministic rule-based lead scoring, notes, and stage history — never outreach, term sheets, or money movement

agentPrompts.label: Show me the funnel overview
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-lead-funnel` skill in this folder, then show the funnel summary — per-stage lead counts, conversion rates between stages, and the rejection rate.

agentPrompts.label: What's new or freshly scored to review?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-lead-funnel` skill in this folder, then list the leads sitting in New or Scored with their score and suggested next action, so I know which ones need a stage decision.

agentPrompts.label: Help me triage a lead
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-lead-funnel` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then open the lead I name, walk me through its score breakdown and suggested next action, and carry out the stage move, rejection with reason, or note I decide on. Never send outreach, sign a term sheet, or move money — this board only ever writes stage, rejection reason, and notes.
